s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon. Mix 250g crab meat with mayonnaise, lemon zest and breadcrumbs, shape into small cakes and pan-fry until golden. Stir lemon juice into more mayonnaise for aioli and arrange it all on silver trays.

Bring 150g each of brie, vintage cheddar and blue cheese to room temperature. Arrange on a black slate with bunches of grapes, halved figs and a stack of crackers. Set out with small knives so the guests can help themselves.

m.how: Layer thinly sliced potatoes with cream and bake at 180C for an hour. Sear 4 eye fillet steaks hard in butter, then roast at 200C to 54C and rest. Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock and reduce until glossy. Serve with charred asparagus.

w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, then mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a blind-baked sweet shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream.

d.note: the launch party at the agency
d.how: Sit the bottle in an ice bucket with water and ice for 30 minutes. Drop a raspberry into each tall flute. Open the bottle gently with a sigh rather than a pop, and pour slowly so the bubbles do not spill over the rim.
